violations.why: After irq_jasper enables interrupt 2, irq_nimbus (v_falcon==1) can preempt the task between the two reads and change v_hazel, so the two comparisons see different values.
irq_nimbus can run between the two reads of v_meadow once irq_jasper has enabled it, and it writes v_meadow.
irq_jasper is never masked in the task, so it can preempt between the two reads and write v_meadow.
